title: Roon Server
tagline: Music software that transforms your listening experience
description: Roon music software transforms your listening experience with rich metadata, discovery features, and audiophile sound. It works with streaming services and local files. RoonServer is the central server component for your library and is controlled from the Roon app; it does not provide a browser WebUI.
release_note:
- Uses the latest RoonServer Production release.
- RoonServer is downloaded on first start and stored in `/Roon`.
- RoonServer updates automatically within the Production release channel.

tips.before_install: RoonServer has no WebUI. After installation, use the Roon app on a device on the same LAN to discover and configure this server.
